paths.description: Regional availability notice at the requested URL on a narrow mobile viewport; represents the only target-domain page reachable from this EEA run.
Same static notice at desktop width to assess responsive/card adaptation.
Same notice under dark mode, reduced motion, and forced-colors/high-contrast preferences.
Raw/no-JavaScript crawler comparison for progressive enhancement and discoverability.

findings.summary: The notice is hard-coded to a light palette and does not follow the user’s dark-mode preference.
findings.evidence: The dark-condition screenshot is visually identical to the default mobile screenshot; the computed color-scheme is “normal” and the page reports no dark-theme adaptation.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme: light dark and provide dark surface, text, border, and link tokens using prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: Document navigation has no transition treatment.
findings.evidence: DOM inspection found no view-transition opt-in and all service/help navigation uses ordinary links that open abrupt new document states.
findings.suggestedFix: For same-origin destinations, opt pages into cross-document View Transitions with a reduced-motion-safe fallback; keep external navigation conventional.

findings.summary: The 2,422px mobile notice provides no scroll-position feedback.
findings.evidence: Layout measured a 2,422px page in an 844px viewport; DOM/CSS inspection found no sticky progress or scroll-state-aware navigation.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a lightweight reading-progress indicator or scroll-state-aware section affordance for the long bilingual notice.

findings.summary: The reusable card layout adapts only at page/viewport level, not at component level.
findings.evidence: Desktop and mobile screenshots show the same card archetype at different widths, while stylesheet probing found no @container rules or container context.
findings.suggestedFix: Give the notice/card wrapper a container context and move card-specific width and spacing adaptations into container queries.

findings.summary: Most links have touch hit areas shorter than 24px.
findings.evidence: The input probe found 17 of 20 interactive links with rendered heights from 14px to 21px, including footer links at 14px; keyboard focus itself remained visible.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase inline link padding/line box size so standalone service and footer controls have comfortably sized touch targets without harming text flow.

findings.summary: Link colors fail WCAG minimum contrast throughout the notice and footer.
findings.evidence: axe found 20 contrast failures: #1a75ff on white measured 4.17:1, #1f78ff on white 4.04:1, and footer links on #eee 3.59:1, below the required 4.5:1.
findings.suggestedFix: Use darker link tokens that reach at least 4.5:1 in every surface and verify default, hover, visited, and focus states.

findings.summary: The heading and landmark hierarchy is malformed.
findings.evidence: axe reports no h1 and a contentinfo footer nested inside main; DOM order starts with h3 then h2. The focus outline is visible, but structural navigation is not logical.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a single descriptive h1, nest subsequent headings in order, and move the footer outside main so landmarks are top-level peers.

findings.summary: The viewport explicitly disables user zoom.
findings.evidence: The rendered viewport meta contains user-scalable=no; axe classifies this as a critical accessibility violation. The narrow layout otherwise reflows without horizontal overflow.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove user-scalable=no and preserve width=device-width, initial-scale=1 so users can pinch-zoom while the layout continues to reflow.

findings.summary: The logo is substantially oversized and lacks a complete intrinsic size.
findings.evidence: The images primitive measured a 1,933px-wide PNG rendered at 170px, with no height attribute, no srcset, and no modern-format alternative.
findings.suggestedFix: Export a right-sized WebP/AVIF (or SVG logo), provide width and height, and add an appropriate srcset only if multiple display densities are needed.

findings.summary: The page has no meta description.
findings.evidence: The DOM probe found a descriptive title but meta[name=description] was absent; raw HTML likewise had no description.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a concise Japanese/English meta description explaining the regional availability notice and available alternatives.

findings.summary: The regional notice is served as HTTP 403 and exposes no canonical or crawl-policy endpoints.
findings.evidence: HAR and raw fetch both recorded HTTP 403 for the document; canonical and hreflang were absent, and /robots.txt plus /sitemap.xml also returned 403 from this region.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve the explanatory notice with a crawlable success response where policy permits, publish explicit robots/sitemap behavior, and add a canonical URL plus language alternates for the bilingual content.

findings.summary: Core browser security headers are missing.
findings.evidence: The headers primitive confirmed HTTPS and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN, but found no CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy.
findings.suggestedFix: Add HSTS, nosniff, a restrictive CSP (including frame-ancestors), a privacy-preserving Referrer-Policy, and a least-privilege Permissions-Policy.

findings.summary: The bilingual Japanese/English document has no language metadata.
findings.evidence: DOM and axe both report an empty html lang attribute; the English section also has no local lang="en" annotation.
findings.suggestedFix: Set html lang="ja" and mark the English article lang="en"; use dir only where needed and retain logical layout properties.

taskList.title: Restore user zoom, enlarge short link targets, and correct heading/landmark structure
Make the regional notice crawlable with canonical and language metadata
Fix link contrast in content and footer surfaces
Serve a right-sized logo with complete dimensions
Honor dark mode and refine long-page responsive navigation
Consider same-origin cross-document transitions where relevant
